original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system completes 100 AC off/on cycles at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails, restoring all devices and services without unexpected errors or hangs.
original_method: Freeze complete serial/slot inventory; establish a dry cold chamber, rated interlocked AC fixture, measured +5% rails, true-off/discharge and on dwell plus boot/readiness deadlines; preserve baseline logs; perform exactly 100 supervised cycles with per-cycle power-state, POST/OS/BMC readiness, inventory and event evidence; abort without silent retry, warm above dew point and restore nominal state.
manual_activity: Operator controls dry chamber/high rails and AC fixture, supervises 100 cycles and performs safe warm-up.
required_inputs: AC fixture/feed/inrush rating and true-off proof
Off/discharge/on dwell, auto-power and readiness deadlines
safety_requirements: Use interlocked equipment rated for load and inrush
Preserve logs and never silently retry
Abort on electrical, moisture, thermal, boot or device fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening
agent_execution_scope: Must not switch mains, control chamber/rails or decide DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve fixture, timing, cold profile and oracle

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain a 100-entry ledger binding fixture transitions, readiness, inventory/events and dew-point/rail measurements.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds inventory, inrush-safe fixture, explicit timing/readiness, condensation control, no-retry rule and warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A final successful boot cannot prove all intermediate cycles recovered every device.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cold starts plus elevated rails can expose intermittent initialization/inrush behavior, while chamber opening before safe warm-up adds unrelated condensation risk.
